summary.policy: Exact whole-string matches against chinese_name, each aliases entry, and display_name. No substring/fuzzy/scientific-synonym/cultivar merging or spelling correction. Primary > alias > display precedence; retain all matched IDs.
summary.note: Name entries are not distinct species. Unmatched names can be cultivars, alternate names, spelling differences, or gaps. Catalog matches do not imply recognition-model support.
